summary: Pure deterministic unit-edge graph queries returning ordered shortest distances and canonical first steps.
useWhen: Select a stateless search implementation for a finite legal graph; games supply ordered adjacency and retain occupancy, movement and resource-cost policy.
limitations: Every edge costs one step; no weighted paths, A*, continuous movement, world collision or smoothing.
Results are pure advisory queries, not movement commits. Consumers rebuild legality at commit.
Static content validation is separate from this runtime selection seam; the plugin has no graph content kind, owned handles or cache.
